recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast monochrome studio portrait of two men in formal attire and nautical-inspired hats, overlaid with large, vibrant cyan geometric lettering that spans the width of the composition at a slight upward angle.
coreVisualRelationships: Monochrome subjects against a stark white background
Vibrant cyan text acting as a foreground barrier
Diagonal typographic alignment contrasting with vertical subjects
Textured black suits against flat, saturated graphic elements
coreInvariants: Black and white photography for subjects
Bright cyan (hex #00FFFF range) for primary text
Upward 5-10 degree tilt on the main text block

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two figures positioned centrally, waist-up, filling the upper two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large cyan text block in the lower half of the image.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the faces of the subjects, moves down to the bold cyan lettering, and follows the diagonal tilt of the text across the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant white space at the top and sides to isolate the subjects.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme contrast between the desaturated subjects and the high-saturation, high-value cyan text.
paletteRestrictions: Small accents of purple/yellow in secondary logos

letterConstructionRules: Tight kerning with overlapping vertical strokes
Lowercase characters with ascenders reaching the same height as capitals
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 't' has a crossbar that aligns with the top of other letters
The 's' is constructed from three horizontal bars and two vertical connectors
The 'w' is a mirrored 'm' with sharp angles

composition.relationshipToImage: Covers the mid-section of the subjects

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single dominant custom typeface with a small circular graphic emblem.
graphicDevices: Circular emblem with contrasting colors (purple/yellow) placed between letters

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary verticality and weight

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white studio photograph of two men in their 20s wearing suits and nautical hats (one sailor cap, one flat cap) against a pure white background. The lighting should be bright and flat.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, ultra-condensed geometric lowercase text in bright cyan across the lower half of the image. Tilt the text 5 degrees upward. Ensure the letters have a thin black outline to separate them from the dark suits.

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subjects
Any trademarked logos or brand names
postGenerationChecks: Check for clean separation between cyan text and black suits
Ensure the nautical hats are clearly visible
Verify the ultra-condensed nature of the font
Confirm the diagonal alignment of the text
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochrome Studio Portrait + Ultra-Condensed Cyan Typography + Diagonal Layout = 80s Pop Aesthetic
